theme.title: Scoring outbursts
theme.subtitle: Big nights
theme.recap: Wilt owns most of the scoring records, but Devin Booker and Kobe Bryant added 60-plus nights at both ends of a career.

questions.prompt: Devin Booker became the youngest player to score 60 or more, at 20, in a regular-season game. How many points did he score?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Devin Booker (70 points; 20 years and 145 days)

funFacts.text: Booker's historic scoring performance came in a loss to Boston rather than a Phoenix victory.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: against the Boston Celtics, Booker became the sixth player in NBA history to score 70 points in a game

funFacts.text: His night was not just shooting: he also supplied eight rebounds and six assists for the Suns.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Booker also added eight rebounds and six assists in 45 minutes

funFacts.text: Booker's scoring average jumped sharply in his second pro season as his role in Phoenix expanded.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Booker ended the season averaging 22.1 points per game, a near 9-point increment

questions.prompt: How many regular-season 60-point games did Wilt Chamberlain have?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Wilt Chamberlain (32 times); Kobe Bryant (6 times)

funFacts.text: Chamberlain occupies a tier of his own, with many more explosive games than the next man, Kobe Bryant.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Only 10 players have scored 60 or more points on more than one occasion

funFacts.text: Several modern stars have joined the multiple-60 club, including Damian Lillard and James Harden.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Damian Lillard (5 times); Michael Jordan and James Harden (4 times)

funFacts.text: Wilt also set the single-game scoring record at Hershey, Pennsylvania, rather than an NBA team's usual arena.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: at Hershey Sports Arena in Hershey, Pennsylvania

questions.prompt: How many points did Kobe Bryant score in his final NBA game, at age 37?
questions.note: 60, the oldest player ever to score 60.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the oldest is Bryant (60 points; 37 years and 234 days)

funFacts.text: The Lakers later retired both of Kobe's jersey numbers, an unprecedented honor for one NBA player.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: making him the only NBA player to have multiple numbers retired by one franchise

funFacts.text: Kobe had entered the league straight from high school and won a slam dunk contest while still a teenager.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: won the 1997 Slam Dunk Contest, the youngest dunk champion at age 18

funFacts.text: His final seasons were repeatedly interrupted by injuries after the end of his championship years.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: His remaining playing career was hampered by injuries and reduced playing time

questions.prompt: In his 100-point game, Wilt Chamberlain set a record for field-goal attempts. How many shots did he take?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Playing all 48 minutes of the game, Chamberlain set NBA records for field goals attempted (63) and made (36)

funFacts.text: That night was never televised; the surviving recording is a radio call from the final quarter.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The game was not televised, and no video footage of the game has been recovered

funFacts.text: New York began intentionally fouling other Warriors to prevent Wilt from getting the ball in the fourth quarter.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the Knicks began fouling other players to keep the ball away from Chamberlain

funFacts.text: Wilt set a free-throw record despite his reputation as an unreliable shooter from the line.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Chamberlain set five other league records that game, including most free throws made

questions.prompt: In the week of his 100-point game, what did Wilt average over four games?
questions.note: 73 points a game, topping 60 every time.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: He averaged 73 points in four games that week

funFacts.text: In the three earlier games that week, Wilt had already scored enormous totals on successive nights.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: In three earlier games that week, Chamberlain had scored 67, 65, and 61 points respectively

funFacts.text: Coach Frank McGuire built the Warriors offense around feeding his towering center at every opportunity.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: started the season vowing to get the ball to Chamberlain "two-thirds of the time."

funFacts.text: Wilt was close to an unprecedented season scoring total; no other player had reached even three thousand at that point.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: no other player had ever scored 3,000 points at that point
